# toml-test fixtures

The TOML 1.0 cases of [toml-test](https://github.com/toml-lang/toml-test),
release **v2.2.0**: exactly the files its `tests/files-toml-1.0.0` lists (copied
here as `files-toml-1.0.0`), unedited. toml-test is MIT-licensed; its licence
is `LICENSE` beside this file.

`tests/toml.rs` runs them against `std.toml` (milestone 114, PRP-146). To
refresh them, copy the same list from a newer release.
